name: Polarizing filter
definition: filter that cuts glare and reflections and deepens sky colour, linear or circular.

name: Neutral density filter
definition: grey filter that cuts light evenly, or in a graduated band, so longer exposures or wider apertures can be used.

name: Protective filter (UV or clear)
definition: clear or UV-blocking filter fitted to protect the front of a lens.

name: Image-softening filter
definition: mist, diffusion, soft-focus or star filter that softens highlights or adds glow.

name: Camera backpack
definition: backpack made to carry a camera and lenses.

name: Camera shoulder bag
definition: bag worn on one shoulder with padded space for a camera and lenses.

name: Camera sling bag
definition: bag with one strap worn across the body that swings round to the front for quick camera access.

name: Rolling camera case
definition: wheeled case with a handle for carrying camera and lens kit.

name: Camera waist pack
definition: pack worn on a belt or waist to carry a camera and lenses.

name: Film developer
definition: chemistry that turns the exposed latent image on film into a visible image.

name: Paper developer
definition: chemistry that develops the image on exposed printing paper.

name: Stop bath
definition: acid bath that halts development before fixing.

name: Fixer
definition: chemistry that removes unexposed silver halide so the image is permanent.
